conversion_insights.finding: Sessions with non-zero PageValues achieve a 56.3% purchase conversion rate compared to just 3.9% for zero PageValue sessions.
conversion_insights.action: Prioritize user flows and recommendation widgets on pages assigned high PageValue scores.

conversion_insights.finding: Returning visitors generate the majority of total purchase conversions due to accumulated familiarity and intent.
conversion_insights.action: Deploy personalized retargeting, saved cart reminders, and loyalty incentives for returning visitor segments.

conversion_insights.finding: Sessions with ExitRates exceeding 10% experience a sharp conversion decline down to 0.5%.
conversion_insights.action: Implement exit-intent popup offers, live support chat triggers, and checkout simplification on high-exit pages.

conversion_insights.finding: The highest session conversion rate occurs in Nov (25.35%), highlighting key promotional windows.
conversion_insights.action: Align digital ad spend and promotional campaigns ahead of peak conversion months.

actionable_recommendations.Evidence: Sessions with PageValues > 0 convert at over 50%.
actionable_recommendations.Strategy: Trigger express checkout options and inline payment methods as soon as PageValue score increases.

actionable_recommendations.Evidence: Returning visitors account for 85%+ of overall purchase sessions.
actionable_recommendations.Strategy: Provide personalized product recommendations based on past session duration and browsed categories.

actionable_recommendations.Evidence: High Exit Rate (>10%) causes an 80% reduction in conversion likelihood.
actionable_recommendations.Strategy: Redesign high exit-rate product detail pages with customer reviews, trust badges, and stock urgency indicators.

actionable_recommendations.Evidence: Tree ensemble (CatBoost/XGBoost) achieves high PR-AUC on imbalanced session traffic.
actionable_recommendations.Strategy: Serve trained model via REST API to dynamically offer coupon discounts to high-intent but bounce-risk visitors.
